vibe: Warm, nostalgic, traditional Cirebon coastal culinary heritage. Earthy textures (bamboo, wood, teak leaf), editorial storytelling layout, emphasis on the organic beauty of the ingredients.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use 'py-24 md:py-32' for major sections to let the storytelling breathe.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento grid protocol for Philosophy and Ingredients. Mode A (Tetris Grid) for visual tension.

motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling required (use framer-motion or simple CSS smooth scroll). Parallax on hero image.
motion.reveal: Soft vertical fade-ins for text blocks using framer-motion.
motion.hover: Images inside cards scale up 1.05x gracefully on hover. Border colors darken slightly.

components_instructions.navigation: Sticky crystal glassmorphism header (bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5D9C5]/50) containing logo, anchor links, and ID/EN language toggle.
components_instructions.cards: Flat background with 1px delicate border (border-[#E5D9C5]). No heavy drop shadows. Padding inside cards must be generous (p-8).
components_instructions.nutrition_table: Editorial-style table. No grid lines except minimal horizontal borders (border-b border-[#E5D9C5]). Clean typography, highlighting key macros.
components_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#2C4C3B] text-white hover:bg-[#1E3629]. Secondary: border-2 border-[#2C4C3B] text-[#2C4C3B] hover:bg-[#2C4C3B] hover:text-white.

sections.title: HERO
sections.layout: Cinematic full-screen (min-h-[90vh]) split or overlay layout. Hero title 'GASTRONOMI NASI JAMBLANG'. Use gradient overlay from black/60 to transparent to ensure white text readability. Subtitle setting the Cirebon heritage context.

sections.title: Philosophy, Tradition, Social
sections.layout: Bento Grid layout displaying 4 value cards: Daun Jati (Teak Leaf), Kebersamaan (Togetherness), Identitas Budaya (Cultural Identity), and Nilai Sosial. Use subtle icons or textured backgrounds.

sections.title: Main Ingredients
sections.layout: Editorial gallery/grid highlighting: Daun Jati, Nasi Putih, Cumi Hitam (Hero Ingredient), Sambal Goreng. Image on top, elegant descriptive text below.

sections.title: Techniques & Methods
sections.layout: Split-screen layout (sticky image on one side, scrolling text on the other). Showcase Penyajian (buffet), Bakul Anyaman Bambu, Daun Jati, and Tungku Tradisional.

sections.title: Tasting & Sensory
sections.layout: Immersive dark section or rich terracotta background to contrast with the light theme. Annotated visuals highlighting rice texture, leaf aroma, and side dish textures.

sections.title: Serving Aesthetics
sections.layout: Before/After or Side-by-side comparison slider/cards showing Traditional Teak Leaf wrapping vs Modern Plating.

sections.title: Interactive Food Experience
sections.layout: Full width image of the 'Etalase' (display) with interactive hover points or simple narrative text about choosing side dishes and buyer-seller warmth.

sections.title: Nutrition Knowledge
sections.layout: Clean, minimalist editorial table. Calories: 350-500, Protein: 12-20g, Fat: 8-18g, Carbs: 45-60g. Focus on legibility and Swiss-style alignment.

sections.title: Ethics & Etiquette
sections.layout: Centered storytelling layout. Emphasize sustainability (preserving teak leaves, traditional recipes, wood stoves) and 'take only what you need' ethos. Large blockquote typography.
